//: The end-to-end suite, as its own project.
Deliberately NOT referenced from the root tsconfig.json solution, so
`npm run typecheck` / `tsc -b` still cover exactly the three runtimes they
covered before (app / node / server) and a change here cannot break a
production build. Playwright transpiles these files itself.
It exists because eslint.config.js uses typescript-eslint's
`projectService`, which needs every linted .ts file to belong to some
project. Without this file `eslint .` fails on e2e/ before it lints a line.
